INSERT INTO user_location_pref
             (user_id, lat, lon, place_name, is_roam, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now())
           ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
             lat        = EXCLUDED.lat,
             lon        = EXCLUDED.lon,
             place_name = EXCLUDED.place_name,
             is_roam    = EXCLUDED.is_roam,
             updated_at = now()
